answer: Anchor each earning account to a web domain it controls. The agent publishes a public key in a DNS record and each epoch decrypts a fresh nonce sent under that key, a small cipher test proving it still holds the domain. A domain counts only if it was registered months earlier and is bound to one account at a time. An honest agent pays one modest yearly fee; a farm of N fakes must buy, age and renew N separate domains, each like a cedar sapling that takes seasons to grow, so a sudden tide of fresh registrations earns nothing until it ages.
